scope: Main-only learner sidebar, supporting-file read-only editor, and latest user-language payload evidence
sidebar_regressions: Screenshot fixture shows main/main.c only; component, CMake, sdkconfig and reserved board header remain off the Project sidebar.
Custom source/header/assets inside main remain editable; missing main never falls back to supporting files.
New File targets main, and main itself cannot be renamed or deleted from its menu.
Supporting AI changes open read only; manual changes are ignored and Ctrl+S saves only dirty learner program files.
Monaco readOnly and save callbacks follow current props; AI diff Keep/Undo remain usable.
Windows case/separators, traversal, boundary checks, reserved names, and input tree immutability have policy tests.
New File uses atomic create_new and never falls back to an overwrite when a file exists.
Applying an AI proposal to an open supporting file updates both content and savedContent; it stays clean and does not block project Keep/Undo.

language_regressions.scope: Source selection, escaped JSON data and both actual provider message builders; not model response fluency
cases: Thai -> wrapped English try again/retry/continue -> tool outputs
text-part arrays and OpenAI images preserved
tool-response adjacency and Google thought signatures preserved
language_regressions.implementation: Sanitized selected prose is attached as JSON data to an existing user message in the temporary provider payload, never system instructions or saved history.

limitations: Sidebar visibility and read-only editor are app behavior, not filesystem access permissions.
All supporting build files remain on disk; Save As, build and project-level Keep/Undo continue using all files.
No installed app or installer has been replaced by these checks.
Tauri UI behavior is covered through DOM tests with mocked desktop calls; no physical board or live AI provider request was made.
Google OpenAI-format image_url inputs remain unsupported; text parts now reach that provider rather than being dropped.
